app.name: FinLLM
app.description: FinLLM — self-hosted personal ledger: net worth, transactions, budgets, and CSV import.

auth.loginHint: Your personal ledger. Sign in with the email and password from initial setup.
auth.initHint: Self-hosted personal finance. Create the first owner account to initialize this instance.

overview.emptyBody: Record an expense or income under Transactions, or import a CSV to see balances here.
overview.chartEmpty: Not enough data for charts yet.

movements.intro: Record an expense or income in MXN (double-entry applied automatically).
movements.missingAccounts: Create at least one asset account and one {{kind}} account under «New account».

import.accountsIncomplete: Create asset, expense, and income accounts before confirming the import.

budgets.emptyBody: Set a period and amounts per expense account to track spending.

investments.intro: Positions modeled as asset accounts in the ledger. Performance, lots, and IRR are not in this version; use the MCP harness for advanced operations.
investments.emptyBody: No asset accounts with balance. Create an ASSET account under Transactions.

reconciliation.intro: Filter by statement period and mark items reconciled.
reconciliation.emptyBody: Click «Load uncleared items» to search in the selected period.
